metadata.title: छत्तीसगढ़ का पहाड़ी कोरवा: जंगल की बदौलत जिंदा | Pahari Korwa Tribe Of Chhattisgarh
metadata.description:
In the dense forests of Surajpur district in Chhattisgarh, the Pahari Korwa tribe treads a delicate balance between tradition and modernity. Once renowned as hunter-gatherers, they now inhabit settled villages, yet their connection to the jungle remains profound. Government efforts have facilitated their transition to settled life, yet challenges persist. Despite initiatives to support settlement, the tribe still grapples with limited access to resources and infrastructure. While some have embraced aspects of modern living, many still rely on traditional practices for sustenance. This ground report underscores the intricate dance between adaptation and preservation faced by indigenous communities like the Pahari Korwa. It serves as a poignant reminder of the ongoing struggle for cultural preservation and equitable development in remote corners of India.
